native_name: Dassault Aviation SA (Avions Marcel Dassault-Breguet Aviation until 1990)

selection.reason: The French combat-aircraft and business-jet maker. The game already cites Dassault in France's sourced 1990 composite-structures technology, so this dossier extends an existing reference instead of inventing a new aerospace identity.

existing_game_references.note: Evidence text names Dassault (Rafale A demonstrator, 1986).

summary: Avions Marcel Dassault-Breguet Aviation took the name Dassault Aviation in 1990. The Rafale became operational in the French Navy in 2004 and the Air Force in 2006, and export deliveries began in 2015. The 300th Rafale was produced in 2025. The Falcon 6X entered service on 30 November 2023; the Falcon 10X was still in development at the end of 2025. GIMD is the majority shareholder.

roles.role: designer and manufacturer of combat aircraft and business jets

entities.note: The registration number 712 042 456 is unchanged; it moved from RCS Paris to RCS Nanterre after the head-office transfer to Saint-Cloud effective 1 January 2026.

lineage.note: Year precision from the national library record. The company heritage page dates the Board decision to 19 June 1990, but its byte-stability recheck was blocked by bot protection, so the day is not used.

country_links.note: Registered office moved from Paris to Saint-Cloud.
Dassault Falcon Jet Corp. markets and completes Falcons for the Americas.

milestones.note: 14 series aircraft delivered in the year.
80 for the UAE, 6 for Greece, 6 for Indonesia.
First aircraft in final manufacture; no first flight or delivery is recorded.

proposed.uncertainty: Rafale is multirole. The game fighter only defends skies with finite short-range missiles; the naval Rafale Marine would also need carrier aviation (E04).
A strike configuration of the same airframe; one real aircraft must not become two independent company products without a ruling.
Generic legacy fourth-generation tier; arsenal kits have no company stock, so the Mirage retrofit informs flavour only.
The existing evidence (1986 demonstrator) predates the window; it links identity only and grants no mechanic.
Generated contractors are fictional; a real identity would replace one of them, not add a parallel firm.

duplicates_avoided: Dassault Aviation (1990 rename) is one legal person; Avions Marcel Dassault-Breguet Aviation is not a separate company.
Thales, in which Dassault holds a stake, is not merged into this dossier.

integration_flow.summary: A later, reviewed integration could attach this sourced identity to a company created through the existing orders. Design stays with the commissioning country; Defense R&D pays development as work is performed; the company funds tooling, national-warehouse inputs and fabrication from its own settled cash; the buyer purchases whole finished units from company stock; delivery follows fiscal settlement and seven accessible days. Business jets have no civilian aircraft consumer yet and stay outside the supplier flow.

steps.note: Paid capitalisation from Defense procurement (political capital price applies); leases one existing completed Arms Plant slot. No historical factory, balance or stock is granted.
Further paid working capital; unsettled receivables are not spendable cash.
Frozen design revision; Defense R&D pays engineering, prototype and trials work day by day; prototypes are never saleable.
Finite company-owned stock target (0-12 units); a target is never a government order.
Government buys whole units from existing company stock; settlement then seven accessible delivery days.

unmapped: Falcon business jets: no civilian aviation product consumer.
Rafale Marine: needs E04 carrier operations.

gaps: A first probe of dassault-aviation.com received a bot-protection page; later requests succeeded and the guessed /en/group/about-us/history/ address is a 404. Regulated filings carry most claims.
First Rafale delivery dates to each service were not retrieved; only the operational years are recorded.
The exact day of the 1990 rename is not recorded: the company heritage page that dates it failed both byte-stability rechecks (bot-protection pages), so the rename stays at year precision.

future_policy.note: Nothing after the frozen cutoff is predicted. Any later product, successor or business in a campaign must be authored as explicitly fictional game content (labelled "(fictional)") or left unknown.

claims.text: In 1990 the company took the name Dassault Aviation.
The first Rafale units became operational in the French Navy in 2004 and in the French Air Force in 2006; export deliveries began in 2015 (Egypt).
Production of the 300th Rafale was completed a few days before 7 October 2025; 533 Rafale had firm orders from France and eight export countries.
